theorem_status: For every k>=3, the exact cubic recurrence and 80-digit interval bounds prove exactly 3k distinct negative roots in I4; the first actual family case k=2 is verified by exact Sturm. The k=1 polynomial is an auxiliary recurrence seed.

normalized_recurrence.scope: The cubic recurrence is structurally verified for every k>=3 by the 20-state frontier transfer; its instances k=3,4,5 also match exact Ehrhart certificates.

exact_phase_lift.Phi_k: -(k+1)*pi on the upper-half-plane branch; this is not a global analytic coefficient branch
exact_phase_lift.interval_description: I4=(beta_minus,beta_plus) is reciprocal-symmetric, contains t=-1, and covers both sides of -1.
exact_phase_lift.sign_change_consequence: The q6 contacts split I4 into three windows. Their endpoint phase ranges provide k+1 ordered sample levels with alternating signs in each window; the global E2<0.02 and eigenvalue-dominance bounds make the spectral remainder strictly smaller at every sample.

global_interval_audit.three_k_sign_change_conclusion: certified by three q6-separated phase windows, each with k alternating strict signs, for every k>=3

q6_contacts.coefficient_interpretation: one-sided upper-branch limit at a repeated eigenvalue
one-sided upper-branch limit at a repeated eigenvalue

analytic_q6_branch_audit.coefficient_branch_obstruction: At both q6 contacts the one-sided upper-mode coefficient limits have nonzero imaginary part; following the analytic eigenvalue branch requires conjugating that coefficient after a contact, so no single continuous c2 phase lift exists across I4.
analytic_q6_branch_audit.root_count_conclusion: For every k>=3, each of the three open q6-separated windows contains at least k strict sign changes; degree 3k gives exactly 3k distinct negative roots in I4. Exact Sturm verifies the actual k=2 case; k=1 is only an auxiliary recurrence seed.

k1.interpretation: auxiliary recurrence seed, not an Ehrhart polynomial

k2.interpretation: first Ehrhart polynomial in the k>=2 family

degree_growth.degree_Hk: 3*k by induction from the cubic recurrence

global_claims.all_k_real_rootedness: Proved for the order-polytope family: every H_{k,4}, k>=2, has exactly 3k distinct negative roots; for k>=3 all lie in I4. The k=1 polynomial is an auxiliary recurrence seed.
global_claims.all_k_root_count_lower_bound: Exactly 3k distinct negative roots in I4 for every k>=3.
global_claims.right_window_root_count_finite: The all-k I4 theorem excludes roots in (-alpha,0) for k>=3; independent exact Sturm counts verify this for k=3,...,12.

structural_transfer.all_q_ge_3_state_bound: For d_i=h_i-q, sum(d_i)=0 and d_i<=1 imply d_i>=-3; the ideal condition is d_i<=d_(i-1)+1. Thus the local frontier depends on a fixed set of deviations for every q>=3.
structural_transfer.transition_independent_of_q: The transfer adds one row. Its order-ideal constraints use only the last two row masks, and its descent weights use the last vertex's row offset and column.
structural_transfer.recurrence: H[k]=P4*H[k-1]+Q4*H[k-2]+R4*H[k-3] for every k>=3; the transfer gives the relation for k>=6 and exact certificate checks establish k=3,4,5.

requested_second_order_relation.interpretation: The proposed H[k]-P4*H[k-1]-Q4*H[k-2]=R4 relation is false; the verified structural relation is cubic.

structural_transfer.characteristic_polynomial_note: The vector annihilator above suffices for the scalar recurrence; no claim is made that the full 20x20 characteristic polynomial equals this cubic.

borcea_branden.conclusion: The tested global TP2/total-nonnegativity route fails; this does not disprove stability preservation by every possible operator argument.

lee_yang.method: reciprocal reduction H(t)=t^m Q(t+t^-1) and exact Sturm
lee_yang.conclusion: This certifies each supplied polynomial separately; no uniform-in-k Sturm or discriminant argument is established.

discriminant.right_window_regime: For beta_plus<t<0, t<0 and q4(t)>0, so Delta_X(t)>0: the three characteristic roots are real and simple.

real_eigenvalue_dominance.proof_note: For distinct real roots, an equal-modulus pair must be opposite. The tie polynomial factors as above; its negative roots are t=-1 and the reciprocal pair corresponding to z=-10-4*sqrt(5), all outside (-alpha,0).
real_eigenvalue_dominance.dominant_mode_on_right_window: The positive real eigenvalue is uniquely dominant throughout (-alpha,0); its coefficient is positive and nonzero.

spectral_coefficients.initial_values: H0=1, H1=t^3+11*t^2+11*t+1, H2 from exact DP data
spectral_coefficients.endpoint_caveat: The simple-root coefficient formula is undefined at beta_plus (the two largest positive roots coalesce) and at t=0 (lambda_2=lambda_3=0); a uniform coefficient bound on the closed window needs confluent endpoint limits.

finite_root_distribution.exact_count_argument: Sturm counts all degree 3k roots in [-79,-1/79], which lies strictly inside I4; degree saturation leaves no roots in either exterior window.

right_window_spectral_audit.all_k_status: The three-window phase theorem places all 3k roots in I4 for every k>=3; degree saturation excludes roots in both exterior windows. The separate spectral calculation verifies the right window mode structure and the finite k=3,...,12 counts.
